response:
<analysis>Spring Boot 4 moved to Jackson 3 and renamed org.springframework.boot.jackson.JsonComponent to JacksonComponent (same package, spring-boot-jackson). The class is already on tools.jackson (ValueSerializer), only the annotation is left. The script swaps the import and the annotation lines (not comments).</analysis>
<script>
import re

OLD_IMPORT = "import org.springframework.boot.jackson.JsonComponent;"
NEW_IMPORT = "import org.springframework.boot.jackson.JacksonComponent;"

def error_files(p):
    """The case's files that still exist, in order, once each."""
    seen = []
    for e in p.errors:
        path = e.get("file")
        if path and path not in seen and p.exists(path):
            seen.append(path)
    return seen


def fix(p):
    for path in error_files(p):
        text = p.read(path)
        new = text.replace(OLD_IMPORT, NEW_IMPORT) if NEW_IMPORT not in text else text.replace(OLD_IMPORT + "\n", "")
        new = re.sub(r"^(\s*)@JsonComponent\b", r"\1@JacksonComponent", new, flags=re.M)
        if new != text:
            p.write(path, new)
            p.log(f"{path}: @JsonComponent -> @JacksonComponent")
        else:
            p.log(f"{path}: nothing to change")
</script>
